candidate: A (region based: sky flood fill + disc opening R=28 px)
order: left frame edge -> crest -> head tip -> inner arc -> trough
contour_definition: outer edge (sky side) of the dark outline of the great wave; claws / spray removed by a disc opening (R = 28 px) of the non-sky region, so the line bridges every claw at its root with an arc of that radius

head_tip.direction_definition: principal axis (largest second moment of area) of the OVERHANG region = the part of the base contour's interior that lies right of the plumb line through the inner-arc deepest point and above that point (closed polygon: head from that plumb line to the head tip, then underside / inner arc back to the deepest point); oriented towards +X; 0 deg = +X, negative = pointing downward. Chosen because the painted head with claws removed is a blunt mass (right side almost vertical), so local tip-direction definitions are unstable - see direction_alternatives_deg

trough_level.note: Z = 0 of the spec frame (74.7 %); the completed part of the contour ends on this level. The lowest VISIBLE sky point is reported in remeasure.S3.

S1.how: highest point of the smoothed base contour (outer edge of the ink outline, claws / spray removed by the opening); the top is a flat plateau, so x is ill-conditioned: plateau = contour within 2 px of the top row

S2.how: left-most point of the visible inner arc of the base contour (sky / belly boundary, outer edge of the ink line); the boundary is nearly vertical there, so y is ill-conditioned: the y range within 2 px of the left-most x is given

S3.how: lowest pixel of the flood-filled sky inside x = 1800..2300 px (the hollow between the great wave and the right wave): it is the point where the flank of the near wave meets the dark sea band at the foot of Fuji. The real trough under the head is hidden by the near wave, so this is only the lowest VISIBLE water line, not a reliable trough measurement.

S4.how: slope = direction of the chord over +-1.5 % of image height of arclength (one-sided at the ends) on the 'back' segment; positions are arclength offsets from the left dip / from the crest

S6.how: right-most column of the raw body mask (claws included, outer edge of the ink outline) inside the window [1900, 500, 2600, 1000]; y = mean row of that column

S5.how: head tip = right-most point of the base contour between the crest and the junction (claws removed by the opening). principal axis (largest second moment of area) of the OVERHANG region = the part of the base contour's interior that lies right of the plumb line through the inner-arc deepest point and above that point (closed polygon: head from that plumb line to the head tip, then underside / inner arc back to the deepest point); oriented towards +X; 0 deg = +X, negative = pointing downward. Chosen because the painted head with claws removed is a blunt mass (right side almost vertical), so local tip-direction definitions are unstable - see direction_alternatives_deg
